# ROVARD STUDIOS

> ROVARD STUDIOS designs logos, flyers, websites, billboards, vehicle branding and more for people, businesses, churches, organizations and events. Tell us what you need. Based in Canada, working worldwide, in English and French.

Contact: hello@rovardstudio.com · Start a project: https://rovardstudio.com/start/

## Services

- [Logo design and brand identity](https://rovardstudio.com/services/logo-design/): Logo design, brand identity and brand guidelines for new businesses, organizations and personal brands.
- [Flyer, poster and invitation design](https://rovardstudio.com/services/flyer-design/): Flyers, posters, invitations, brochures and event graphics, ready for print or screen.
- [Social media graphics](https://rovardstudio.com/services/social-media-design/): Social media posts, campaign graphics, thumbnails and templates that look like they belong together.
- [Website and landing page design](https://rovardstudio.com/services/website-design/): Website and landing page design that people can actually understand, built to work well on phones.
- [Billboard, banner and signage design](https://rovardstudio.com/services/billboard-and-banner-design/): Billboard, banner, roll-up and shop signage design that reads from across the road.
- [Vehicle branding and wraps](https://rovardstudio.com/services/vehicle-branding/): Vehicle branding and wrap design for cars, vans and delivery vehicles.
- [Presentation and document design](https://rovardstudio.com/services/presentation-design/): Pitch decks, presentations, proposals, reports and company profiles that look important.
- [Packaging and label design](https://rovardstudio.com/services/packaging-design/): Packaging, label and book cover design that gets picked up.
- [Photo and video editing](https://rovardstudio.com/services/photo-and-video-editing/): Photo retouching, video editing and short promotional videos and motion graphics.

## Guides

- [How to brief a designer when you don't know design words](https://rovardstudio.com/blog/how-to-brief-a-designer/): You don't need to say 'kerning' or 'moodboard'. Here's what actually helps a designer help you.
- [Logo or full brand identity: what do you actually need?](https://rovardstudio.com/blog/logo-or-full-brand/): A logo is one piece of a brand. Here's how to tell whether you need just the logo or the whole system.
- [What every flyer needs before it goes out](https://rovardstudio.com/blog/what-every-flyer-needs/): A great-looking flyer that leaves out the date is just a nice picture. A quick checklist.
- [What to send us before we start your logo](https://rovardstudio.com/blog/what-to-send-before-your-logo/): Five small things that make the first round of your logo much closer to what you imagined.
- [Keeping your brand consistent across social media](https://rovardstudio.com/blog/keep-your-brand-consistent/): When your posts all look like they came from the same place, people remember you. Simple habits that help.
- [Packaging that gets picked up: three things to get right](https://rovardstudio.com/blog/packaging-that-gets-picked-up/): On a crowded shelf, you have a second or two. Where to spend your design effort.
- [How to choose colours for your brand](https://rovardstudio.com/blog/choosing-brand-colours/): Colour is the fastest way people recognize you. Here's how to choose a small set that works.
- [Choosing fonts without overthinking it](https://rovardstudio.com/blog/choosing-fonts/): Two fonts are usually enough. How to pick them and how to use them well.
- [How to give feedback on a design](https://rovardstudio.com/blog/how-to-give-design-feedback/): Good feedback gets you to the right design faster. A simple way to give it.
- [Business cards people actually keep](https://rovardstudio.com/blog/business-cards-people-keep/): A card only works if it's still around next week. What makes people hold on to one.
- [Preparing files for print: bleed, size and colour](https://rovardstudio.com/blog/preparing-files-for-print/): Three small details that decide whether your print job comes back right.
- [Designing a poster for a church or community event](https://rovardstudio.com/blog/designing-an-event-poster/): People walk past posters quickly. Here's how to make yours worth stopping for.
